name: fast_overtake
description: Rear-approach stressor: a fast vehicle comes from BEHIND the drone along the corridor and overtakes with small lateral offset, timed to pass mid-flight; a crossing pedestrian ahead forces the drone off the centerline at the same moment. Stresses KF on high closing speed from astern + the certificate on a mover whose keep-out sweeps THROUGH the corridor axis. HONESTY: replay_core perception is range-gated (14 m, no cone), so the drone 'sees' the rear approach; the true blind-rear semantics need the cone-gated render harness / future realistic front-end.
